summary: Master PPP financial modeling and risk assessment. Build bankable SPV models, optimize risk allocation, and secure infrastructure funding. Enroll today.
lede: Infrastructure financial modelling connects project cash flows, funding needs and risk scenarios for public-private partnerships. For analysts, project finance managers and investment advisers, this training addresses the practical task of testing bankability and public-sector affordability through integrated forecasts. You’ll build cash-flow and debt-service models, assess risk allocation, and use demand, cost and financing sensitivities to compare affordability and project outcomes.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who already work with project budgets, investment cases, contracts, or risk information and need stronger PPP modeling capability. Each role can apply the methods to infrastructure transactions, service concessions, or capital projects subject to local governance and procurement requirements.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of financial statements, spreadsheet formulas, project budgets, or investment appraisal. Familiarity with infrastructure contracts or risk registers is useful but not essential. No programming is required. Advanced Monte Carlo simulation and AI-assisted analysis are introduced at operational application level, while the course focuses hands-on practice on Microsoft Excel model construction, scenario analysis, and reporting.
